claim: The newly added catch prevents an exception thrown by the logging provider from reaching the caller awaiting SendMessageAsync.
mechanism: A processing exception enters the outer catch, LogProcessingError throws another exception, and the inner catch permits normal completion after NotifyStatusChanged.
consequence: The awaiting caller cannot observe the logging-provider exception.
proposedRemedy: Remove the inner catch so the logging-provider exception propagates.
repro: Construct UIAgent with an IChatClient whose streaming response throws ProcessingFailure and an ILoggerFactory returning a logger that enables Error, ignores other levels and throws LoggingFailure from Log at Error. Construct AgentContext with that UIAgent. Await SendMessageAsync and inspect whether LoggingFailure propagates.
